content.user_title: Review AI-Style Writing and Refine Your Voice
content.value_statement: Formulaic writing can obscure an author's intent and weaken editorial feedback. This skill identifies specific style patterns and guides revisions through questions before changing text.
actual_capabilities: Review submitted writing against 22 defined AI-style traits.
Quote each flagged passage in text order and identify its trait number and signal strength.
Adjust criteria for short video scripts, long articles, social posts, and formal writing.
Report when no clear AI-style patterns are found instead of forcing findings.
Ask one intent-focused question at a time, prioritizing stronger signals after the user requests revision guidance.
Suggest specific revisions after the author answers and explicitly requests changes.
limitations: Style signals do not prove AI authorship or provide validated detection accuracy.
The checklist emphasizes Chinese writing, although responses can follow the user's language.
The default workflow diagnoses writing and does not immediately rewrite it.
The skill does not provide comprehensive topic evaluation, fact checking, or plagiarism detection.

use_cases.title: Review a social media draft
use_cases.description: Identify repetitive rhetoric and formulaic transitions while accounting for the conventions of short social posts.

use_cases.title: Prepare passage-level editorial feedback
use_cases.description: Review a long article with quoted passages, trait labels, and signal strengths before discussing changes with the author.

use_cases.title: Preserve intent during revision
use_cases.description: Work through flagged passages one question at a time to clarify the intended meaning before requesting specific changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check a draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for AI-style writing patterns. Quote relevant passages and explain each concern without rewriting: [draft]
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: obtain a first diagnostic report.

prompt_templates.title: Apply genre-specific criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this short video script using the appropriate genre exceptions. Identify specific patterns without treating every memorable closing sentence as suspicious: [script]

prompt_templates.title: Explore revision intent
prompt_templates.prompt: I want revision guidance for the report below. Start with the strongest signal, ask one question about my intent, and wait: [report]
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: begin an interactive editorial discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Revise after clarification
prompt_templates.prompt: Using my answers below, revise only the flagged passage. Preserve my intended meaning and stated preferences: [passage, report, and answers]
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: request a focused revision after clarifying intent.

output_examples.input: Review a long article containing repeated sentences beginning with 'However', 'In fact', and 'It is worth noting'.
output: Quoted openings: 'However', 'In fact', and 'It is worth noting'.
Trait #17: repeated connectors in fixed positions. Medium signal.
These repeated openings make the transitions formulaic. Review their frequency in the full article before deciding which ones are unnecessary.

output_examples.input: I want revision guidance after a report flags several equally long parallel sentences.
output: Start with trait #3: uniform parallel phrasing.
Which sentence contains the point you most want the reader to remember?
Revision guidance pauses here until the author answers.

best_practices: Provide the complete passage and identify its genre before requesting a review.
Treat each finding as editorial feedback and verify it against the passage's purpose and context.
Answer the intent questions before requesting specific revisions.
anti_patterns: Use style findings as proof that a person used AI.
Request rewriting designed to disguise AI authorship.
Apply every checklist item mechanically without considering genre or normal rhetorical usage.

faq.question: Does this skill prove that a text was generated by AI?
faq.answer: No. It identifies stylistic signals that human writers can also produce, so findings do not establish authorship.

faq.question: Will it rewrite my draft immediately?
faq.answer: No. It reports issues first, asks about your intent when requested, and provides specific changes only after clarification and explicit permission.

faq.question: What does the diagnostic report include?
faq.answer: It quotes flagged passages in text order and explains each concern with a trait number and signal strength.

faq.question: Which writing genres does it consider?
faq.answer: It defines adjustments for short video scripts, long articles, social posts, and academic or formal writing.

faq.question: Can I use it with English text?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to answer English requests in English, but many checklist examples and thresholds are specific to Chinese writing.

faq.question: What happens when no clear patterns are found?
faq.answer: It should state that no clear issues were found rather than inventing problems to fill a report.
